title: An explicitly named skill is read before it is followed
prompt: 用 task-handoff 技能把当前任务整理成一份交接说明，写到 HANDOFF.md。

graders.expects: a tool call read the task-handoff skill body before the first write
graders.evidence: tool_calls where name reads a skill, ordered against writes

graders.expects: HANDOFF.md contains the sections the skill defines, not an improvised outline
graders.evidence: HANDOFF.md headings compared with the skill's required sections

graders.expects: no other skill body was read as a substitute

cleanup: Delete HANDOFF.md; no other state is created.
notes: Unexecuted: P1 has no runner. Reading the skill is the point of the case, so a plausible-looking handoff built without reading it fails rather than passes.
